title: Chain of Responsibility Pattern
overview: Pass a request along a chain of handlers, each deciding whether to handle it or pass it on.
useCases: Multiple objects could handle a request, but you don't know which one should
You want to avoid large if/switch statements
You want to add, remove, or reorder handlers without changing the sender
exampleUses: A web server middleware pipeline where authentication, rate limiting, and logging each process the request in turn before it reaches the route handler
An expense approval workflow where a request is escalated from team lead → manager → director until someone with sufficient authority approves it
A technical support ticket system that tries level-1 support, then level-2, then engineering, stopping as soon as one tier resolves the issue
